subject: Temporary sandbox runway — 3-day credit request during procurement review
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novushealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot runway risk — short interim credits?

Hi Mina,

Quick update from our side: procurement flagged that the PO for the pilot will not be fully processed until next week — legal is still finishing a couple of redlines. We have a group of 5 engineers in the sandbox and about 12 hours of test runs left; if access lapses we'll lose momentum and some scheduled sessions.

Can Redwood provide a short bridging credit (3 days / ~$1,200 worth) so we can complete the final evaluation while procurement wraps? We want to keep the original scope intact and close the PO as soon as legal signs off.

I'm happy to share the expected usage numbers and a billing contact if that helps. Attached a quick csv with current pilot usage estimate (pilot-invoice-estimate.csv).

Thanks — really appreciate any short runway you can provide.

Alex Chen
Director of Data Science, Novus Health
alex.chen@novushealth.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachment: pilot-invoice-estimate.csv (usage snapshot)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway risk — short interim credits?

Hi Alex — thanks for the transparency, and totally get the urgency.

We can provision a short, conditional 72-hour sandbox credit to keep the pilot live while your procurement and legal teams finish their review. A few quick notes:
- The credit covers hosted inference usage up to the amount in your estimate (~$1.2k). If you expect materially higher usage please flag it now.
- We ask for a one-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) signed by your billing contact; I attached our MAP (MAP-Novus-v1.pdf) and we can accept DocuSign. If legal needs more time, we can still enable the credit but will require the billing contact email on file.
- Please confirm the procurement ETA and the billing contact so I can start the approval.

Ben (cc) is on standby for approvals and Monica will be the CS handoff to enable sandbox access once we have the required contact/ack.

If that works, I'll mark this as a temporary credit approval and Monica will enable the sandbox for 72 hours.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: MAP-Novus-v1.pdf (one-page MAP), pilot-invoice-estimate.csv (re-attached)

From: Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@novushealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-21T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway risk — short interim credits?

Hello Mina / Alex,

Procurement update: Legal has a couple of standard indemnity/DP clauses under review; our internal process indicates a formal PO will be issued in approximately 5 business days (target: 2027-03-26). We cannot sign the MAP until legal finishes the redlines, but we can provide the billing contact and a PO reference once the manager signs off later this week.

Request: would Redwood consider extending the temporary credit to 5 calendar days instead of 3 given the expected PO timing? That would ensure the engineering team can complete validation without disruption.

We can share the billing contact: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@novushealth.com> (Billing Manager). If you need SOC 2 or customer evidence, please point to what you require and we'll route it.

Thanks,
Novus Procurement Team
procurement@novushealth.com

Attachment: PO-acknowledgement.pdf (internal note)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-23T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway risk — short interim credits?

Thanks for the update — appreciate the clarity on timing.

We can make a one-time exception and extend the temporary runway to 5 calendar days (same coverage as Mina outlined) provided we have the billing contact on file (Maria Lopez) and a HubSpot deal note referencing the expected PO date. I'll log a quick internal approval now (DEAL-8471).

Monica (cc): please enable a 5-day credit for Novus Health under deal DEAL-8471 and monitor usage; notify us if we see a spike beyond the estimate.

Alex / Procurement: please send Maria's billing email and the PO reference when available — we'll convert the temporary credit to standard billing once PO arrives.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
